analytical_question: Should management authorize a supervised pilot, and what would justify changing course?
general_et_finding: As of 2026-11-15 in the US synthetic landscape, RAG has reported sustained FAQ use (6 of 20 panel respondents) and earlier contract-workflow trial evidence (2 of 20); the panel does not establish market adoption (L2). Maturity and performance vary by workload: the benchmark identifies keyword search and reviewed clause extraction as relevant alternatives and shows different results for FAQs and contracts (L1). The hosted ecosystem includes vendor-managed inference, which receives query text (L3, L6); private supplier availability and integration support are unresolved. The export profile is a draft with no demonstrated interoperability (L4), and regulatory applicability is unassessed. Aggregate funding grew in the tracker (L5). The vendor reports lower demo costs (L3); comparable cost and longitudinal performance trends remain unverified.
application_finding: For contract terms, the closest competitor is clause extraction with analyst review, a different workflow from the incumbent manual review. Hosted RAG reached 72% against reviewed extraction at 96% (L1); only reviewed extraction cleared the 95% case threshold in that benchmark. Validate agreement version tracking and page-level citations against a manual reference set.
organization_specific_finding: Harbor Desk can test in the approved workspace, but missed terms can change renewal obligations. Landscape position as of 2026-11-15 for the six-month contract decision: prioritize evaluation of reviewed clause extraction given the workload-specific benchmark (L1); the alternative’s 96% result still needs local replication and traceability checks.
value_opportunity_implication: Compare analyst review time and missed terms against manual review.
risk_governance_implication: Retain analyst sign-off and require agreement-version and page-level provenance for deadline-sensitive findings.
recommendation_management_implication: Evaluate reviewed clause extraction alongside manual review and defer operational reliance on hosted RAG pending stronger workload evidence.
change_monitoring_triggers: Watch source-supported term extraction and version/page traceability in the procurement QA set. Refresh after each versioned evaluation round and before operational use. Revisit RAG's suitability and whether to advance it only after at least 95% source-supported extraction on the local held-out set with verified page and version provenance (L1 baseline: 72%, 2026-10-20).
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Request a local analyst-labeled set that includes amendments, renewals, and termination notices.

evidence.claim: Synthetic held-out workload benchmark. Internal support FAQ: hosted RAG 91% source-supported answers, search 88%; contractual terms: hosted RAG 72%, clause extraction with analyst review 96%. Workloads have distinct evaluation sets; no cost comparison.
evidence.source_or_reference: Synthetic fixture L1, Neutral Systems Lab, Comparative Retrieval Evaluation
evidence.notes: Held-out synthetic workload results. Each workload has its own test set.

evidence.claim: Synthetic convenience panel, fielded August–September 2026. Six of 20 respondents report sustained internal FAQ use; two trial contract workflows. No representative adoption estimate.
evidence.source_or_reference: Synthetic fixture L2, IT Operations Consortium, Deployment Panel

evidence.claim: Synthetic hosted RAG release; published architecture sends query text to vendor-managed inference and claims a 20% cost reduction on its demo workload. Trade brief reprints the same number, so both count as one origin.
evidence.source_or_reference: Synthetic fixture L3, FableCloud, Release Notes and Data Flow
evidence.notes: Vendor demo claim and its reprint share one origin.

evidence.claim: Synthetic draft for document and citation export. No final version or interoperability test is supplied. The packet contains no applicable regulatory material.
evidence.source_or_reference: Synthetic fixture L4, Open Retrieval Forum, Interchange Profile v0.8
evidence.notes: Draft only. Implementation and applicable regulatory evidence are missing.

evidence.claim: Synthetic Q3 survey of disclosed financing rounds reports higher aggregate funding across retrieval tooling; the packet establishes no connection to supplier support, price, or delivery.
evidence.source_or_reference: Synthetic fixture L5, Venture Desk, Quarterly Funding Tracker
evidence.notes: Aggregate indicator. No demonstrated change to supplier availability or support.

evidence.claim: Synthetic controlled audit of the evaluated hosted configuration confirms query text leaves the customer boundary. Private deployment feasibility was outside scope.
evidence.source_or_reference: Synthetic fixture L6, Assurance Lab, Hosted RAG Data-Flow Review
evidence.notes: Independent controlled review of the hosted configuration. Private alternatives were outside scope.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Benchmarks are synthetic and workload-specific. The survey is a convenience sample. Repeated vendor claims share one origin; no comparable cost series or applicable regulatory evidence was supplied.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Provisional within the fixture. The key performance comparison comes from one benchmark and requires a local replication.
